question_en:
I am reviewing the mobile sample ballots for the May 3, 2025, Local Entities and Special Election. Based on the full range of Ballot Styles listed in the official Ballot Sheet Legend for this election, please answer:

How many voting sections are on the first page of each sample ballot, and which styles should enter "High-Density First-Screen Review"? A voting section must begin with a gray header bar, followed by candidates or measures for voters to select. Gray backgrounds for explanatory text, signatures, and watermarks are not counted separately. A style is marked as a hit if the first page has at least 3 voting sections. What are the complete style-by-style table, all qualifying styles, and the hit count? The table must include the Ballot Style number, the number of voting sections on the first page, and whether it enters High-Density First-Screen Review.

The answer must include a complete style-by-style table in the format "Ballot Style Number—Number of Voting Sections on First Page—Enters High-Density First-Screen Review," followed by a Q&A section listing all qualifying styles and their count.

Q: Which styles should enter "High-Density First-Screen Review," and how many are there in total?

A: Ballot Style 03, Ballot Style 05, Ballot Style 09, Ballot Style 11, Ballot Style 13, Ballot Style 14, Ballot Style 16, Ballot Style 18; 8 styles in total.
